lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense cluster of small, high-luminance circular spots is situated immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, transitioning into a series of larger, more widely spaced blobs arranged in approximately horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern across the visible central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance upper edges and lower-intensity shadow regions immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two smaller fish (likely remoras) swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface below the pectoral fin; a unique circular-whorl arrangement of spots is visible in the region directly posterior to the branchial area.
